subject: wood-technology
general_outcomes: By the end of senior school, the learner should be able to:
To gain a comprehensive understanding of the basic principles of wood technology, including the properties, classification, and sustainable use of wood as a natural resource.
To identify and work with various wood materials and composites, understanding their applications and the processes involved in their preparation and treatment.
To acquire practical skills in timber processing techniques, enabling them to design, produce, and evaluate a range of wood products while adhering to safety standards and sustainability practices.
To enhance their technical drawing skills, essential for creating accurate and detailed plans for wood products, thus bridging the gap between conceptual designs and finished projects.
To appreciate benefits of evolution of technology and its application in Wood Technology
